harvestMonths.notes: Actual named managed orchard in the 2016/17 primary experiment. Both quince plots list May. Planting year establishes study context, not first-bearing age.

yearsToFirstCrop.notes: No locally qualified numeric first-crop age was established in the checked primary sources. Record planting date, nursery starting age and propagation method.

yearsToFullBearing.notes: No measured local numeric full-bearing age was established. No yield ramp is inferred.

yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: No qualified mature per-plant food kg with age, product basis and management context was established. Missing output remains unknown rather than zero.

chillUnits.notes: No universal numeric chilling requirement is assigned. Check the actual cultivar and site's winter conditions.

pollination.notes: Check the actual cultivar's pollen needs; no universal classification is inferred from a named cultivar.

supplementaryReferences.title: Robertson irrigation and food end-use context
supplementaryReferences.quote: Most fruits are used for drying or canning
supplementaryReferences.doc: Birkhofer et al. (2019), Effects of Ground Cover Management in Organic Deciduous Fruit Orchards in South Africa, Table 1
supplementaryReferences.note: The study documents summer irrigation and managed organic fruit production. It supplies no validated home processing recipe or shelf life.

care: The Portuguese-quince May reference comes from irrigated Robertson orchards. Record local first and last picking months before treating it as food available.
Keep preserved-stock dates separate from fruit picking; a canning end use does not establish safe shelf life.
purchase: Portuguese quince has a source-backed Robertson orchard reference. Ask for a fruiting quince cultivar: quince names used as pear rootstocks are not a fruit-harvest recommendation.

sourceChecks.observations: Verified live against the primary page or author-provided institutional abstract; regional, cultivar, product and evidence limits retained in this dossier.

gaps: No verified local calendar elsewhere or generic first/full-bearing age, mature kg or chill requirement.
Tree counts, planting years and plot areas cannot be converted to harvest kg without harvested weight.
No species-wide pollination claim or safe preparation/storage instruction derived from the ecological trial.
